items.question: Trong câu "It is difficult to retain historical versions.", từ "retain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is difficult to retain historical versions.", what does "retain" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to keep, to hold on to
items.explanation: retain /rɪˈteɪn/ (động từ): giữ lại, lưu giữ. "Retain historical versions" = lưu giữ các phiên bản cũ; danh từ liên quan: retention (sự lưu giữ).
items.explanationEn: retain /rɪˈteɪn/ (verb): to keep, to hold on to. "Retain historical versions" means keeping older versions; related noun: retention.

items.question: Trong câu "Change management is clumsy.", từ "clumsy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Change management is clumsy.", what does "clumsy" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: clumsy /ˈklʌm.zi/ (tính từ): vụng về, bất tiện. Dùng cho quy trình hay công cụ khó dùng: "a clumsy process" = một quy trình vụng về, rườm rà.
items.explanationEn: clumsy /ˈklʌm.zi/ (adjective): awkward and inefficient. Used for awkward tools or processes: "a clumsy process" is one that is hard to work with.

items.question: Trong câu "It is hard to subset out the requirements allocated to a particular iteration, or to track those once approved but then deferred or canceled.", từ "defer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is hard to subset out the requirements allocated to a particular iteration, or to track those once approved but then deferred or canceled.", what does "defer" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: defer /dɪˈfɜːr/ (động từ): hoãn lại, dời lại. "Deferred requirements" = các yêu cầu bị hoãn sang đợt sau; "defer to someone" lại nghĩa là nghe theo ai.
items.explanationEn: defer /dɪˈfɜːr/ (verb): to postpone, to delay. "Deferred requirements" are pushed to a later release; "defer to someone" instead means to yield to them.

items.question: Trong câu "On exploratory or highly volatile projects where you are not sure what solution you will end up with, keeping up with changes in the details adds little value.", từ "volatile" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On exploratory or highly volatile projects where you are not sure what solution you will end up with, keeping up with changes in the details adds little value.", what does "volatile" (adjective) mean?
options: hay biến động, dễ thay đổi
items.explanation: volatile /ˈvɒl.ə.taɪl/ (tính từ): hay biến động, dễ thay đổi. "Volatile requirements" = yêu cầu thay đổi liên tục; trong hoá học "volatile" là dễ bay hơi.
items.explanationEn: volatile /ˈvɒl.ə.taɪl/ (adjective): likely to change quickly. "Volatile requirements" change often; in chemistry "volatile" means evaporating easily.

items.question: Trong câu "The acts of specification and modeling help project participants think through and precisely state important things that a verbal discussion can leave ambiguous.", từ "think through" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The acts of specification and modeling help project participants think through and precisely state important things that a verbal discussion can leave ambiguous.", what does "think through" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: think through /θɪŋk θruː/ (cụm từ): suy nghĩ thấu đáo. "Think something through" = cân nhắc kỹ mọi khía cạnh trước khi quyết định.
items.explanationEn: think through /θɪŋk θruː/ (phrase): to consider carefully. "Think something through" means to consider all its aspects before deciding.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not rely on telepathy as a substitute for solid requirements specification practices.", từ "substitute" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not rely on telepathy as a substitute for solid requirements specification practices.", what does "substitute" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: substitute /ˈsʌb.stɪ.tjuːt/ (danh từ): vật/cách thay thế. "A substitute for X" = thứ dùng thay cho X; "no substitute for" = không gì thay thế được.
items.explanationEn: substitute /ˈsʌb.stɪ.tjuːt/ (noun): something used instead. "A substitute for X" is used in place of X; "there is no substitute for" means nothing can replace it.

items.question: Trong câu "On most projects it is neither realistic nor necessary to pin down every requirement detail early.", từ "pin down" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On most projects it is neither realistic nor necessary to pin down every requirement detail early.", what does "pin down" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: pin down /pɪn daʊn/ (cụm từ): xác định rõ, chốt lại. "Pin down the details" = chốt chính xác các chi tiết; nghĩa đen là ghim chặt xuống.
items.explanationEn: pin down /pɪn daʊn/ (phrase): to define precisely. "Pin down the details" means to fix them exactly; literally, to fasten something with a pin.

items.question: Trong câu "The software requirements specification (SRS) states the functions and capabilities a software system must provide, its characteristics, and the constraints it must respect.", từ "constraint" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The software requirements specification (SRS) states the functions and capabilities a software system must provide, its characteristics, and the constraints it must respect.", what does "constraint" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (danh từ): ràng buộc, giới hạn. "Design and implementation constraints" = ràng buộc về thiết kế và triển khai; cụm: "within the constraints of".
items.explanationEn: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (noun): a limit or restriction. "Design and implementation constraints" limit how you build it; collocation: "within the constraints of".

items.question: Trong câu "A single deliverable often cannot meet the needs of all audiences.", từ "deliverable" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A single deliverable often cannot meet the needs of all audiences.", what does "deliverable" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an item to be handed over
items.explanation: deliverable /dɪˈlɪv.ər.ə.bəl/ (danh từ): sản phẩm bàn giao. Trong quản lý dự án, "deliverable" là tài liệu/sản phẩm phải bàn giao, ví dụ SRS.
items.explanationEn: deliverable /dɪˈlɪv.ər.ə.bəl/ (noun): an item to be handed over. In project management a "deliverable" is a document or product you must hand over, such as an SRS.

items.question: Trong câu "every project should baseline an agreement for each set of requirements before implementing them.", từ "baseline" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "every project should baseline an agreement for each set of requirements before implementing them.", what does "baseline" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to fix as a reference point
items.explanation: baseline /ˈbeɪs.laɪn/ (động từ): chốt làm mốc chuẩn. "Baseline the requirements" = chốt bộ yêu cầu đã duyệt làm mốc, mọi thay đổi sau đó phải qua kiểm soát.
items.explanationEn: baseline /ˈbeɪs.laɪn/ (verb): to fix as a reference point. "Baseline the requirements" means freezing an approved set so later changes go through change control.

items.question: Trong câu "If your organization tackles various kinds or sizes of projects — large new systems as well as minor enhancements — adopt a template for each major project class.", từ "tackle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If your organization tackles various kinds or sizes of projects — large new systems as well as minor enhancements — adopt a template for each major project class.", what does "tackle" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to deal with, to take on
items.explanation: tackle /ˈtæk.əl/ (động từ): xử lý, đảm nhận. "Tackle a problem/project" = bắt tay giải quyết một vấn đề/dự án.
items.explanationEn: tackle /ˈtæk.əl/ (verb): to deal with, to take on. "Tackle a problem or project" means to start dealing with it seriously.

items.question: Trong câu "Design and implementation constraints (with the rationale for each)", từ "rationale" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Design and implementation constraints (with the rationale for each)", what does "rationale" (noun) mean?
options: lý do, cơ sở lập luận
items.explanation: rationale /ˌræʃ.əˈnɑːl/ (danh từ): lý do, cơ sở lập luận. "The rationale for X" = lý do đằng sau X; nên ghi rationale kèm mỗi ràng buộc.
items.explanationEn: rationale /ˌræʃ.əˈnɑːl/ (noun): the reasons behind a decision. "The rationale for X" explains why X exists; record it alongside each constraint.

items.question: Trong câu "Populate sections as you accumulate information during the course of the project.", từ "populate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Populate sections as you accumulate information during the course of the project.", what does "populate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: populate /ˈpɒp.jə.leɪt/ (động từ): điền nội dung vào. "Populate a template/database" = điền dữ liệu vào; nghĩa khác: cư dân sinh sống ở một vùng.
items.explanationEn: populate /ˈpɒp.jə.leɪt/ (verb): to fill with content. "Populate a template or database" means filling it with data; another sense is people living in an area.

items.question: Trong câu "begin with a rich template with many categories, then condense it for each situation.", từ "condense" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "begin with a rich template with many categories, then condense it for each situation.", what does "condense" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: condense /kənˈdens/ (động từ): rút gọn, cô đọng. "Condense a template" = rút gọn mẫu cho phù hợp; trong vật lý là ngưng tụ.
items.explanationEn: condense /kənˈdens/ (verb): to make shorter. "Condense a template" means shrinking it to fit; in physics it means turning vapour into liquid.

items.question: Trong câu "Use visual emphasis (bold, underline, italics, colour, fonts) consistently and judiciously.", từ "judiciously" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use visual emphasis (bold, underline, italics, colour, fonts) consistently and judiciously.", what does "judiciously" (adverb) mean?
options: về mặt pháp lý, tư pháp
một cách khôn ngoan, có chừng mực
optionsEn: in a legal or court way
items.explanation: judiciously /dʒuːˈdɪʃ.əs.li/ (trạng từ): một cách khôn ngoan, có chừng mực. "Use X judiciously" = dùng X có cân nhắc, không lạm dụng; đừng nhầm với "judicially" (thuộc toà án).
items.explanationEn: judiciously /dʒuːˈdɪʃ.əs.li/ (adverb): with good judgement. "Use X judiciously" means sparingly and wisely; do not confuse it with "judicially" (by a court).

items.question: Trong câu "Enlist a skilled editor to make the document coherent with consistent vocabulary and layout.", từ "enlist" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Enlist a skilled editor to make the document coherent with consistent vocabulary and layout.", what does "enlist" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: enlist /ɪnˈlɪst/ (động từ): nhờ tới, mời tham gia. "Enlist someone's help" = tranh thủ sự giúp đỡ của ai; nghĩa khác là nhập ngũ.
items.explanationEn: enlist /ɪnˈlɪst/ (verb): to get the help of. "Enlist someone's help" means getting them to help; another sense is joining the armed forces.

items.question: Trong câu "Every requirement needs a UNIQUE and PERSISTENT identifier.", từ "persistent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every requirement needs a UNIQUE and PERSISTENT identifier.", what does "persistent" (adjective) mean?
options: cố định, tồn tại lâu dài
items.explanation: persistent /pəˈsɪs.tənt/ (tính từ): cố định, tồn tại lâu dài. "A persistent identifier" = mã định danh không đổi dù yêu cầu bị di chuyển; với người thì nghĩa là kiên trì.
items.explanationEn: persistent /pəˈsɪs.tənt/ (adjective): lasting without changing. "A persistent identifier" never changes even if the requirement moves; for people it means determined.

items.question: Trong câu "the number implies no ordering", từ "imply" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the number implies no ordering", what does "imply" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: imply /ɪmˈplaɪ/ (động từ): ngụ ý, hàm ý. "X implies Y" = X ngầm cho thấy Y; danh từ: implication (hàm ý).
items.explanationEn: imply /ɪmˈplaɪ/ (verb): to suggest without saying. "X implies Y" means X suggests Y without stating it; noun: implication.

items.question: Trong câu "inserting a requirement increments the numbers of all following requirements in that section", từ "increment" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "inserting a requirement increments the numbers of all following requirements in that section", what does "increment" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: increment /ˈɪŋ.krə.ment/ (động từ): tăng lên (từng bậc). Trái nghĩa là "decrement"; danh từ "increment" còn chỉ một phần phát triển tăng dần.
items.explanationEn: increment /ˈɪŋ.krə.ment/ (verb): to increase by a step. The opposite is "decrement"; as a noun "increment" also means one step of incremental delivery.

items.question: Trong câu "deleting, inserting, merging, or moving whole sections changes a lot of labels — disrupting every reference to them.", từ "disrupt" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "deleting, inserting, merging, or moving whole sections changes a lot of labels — disrupting every reference to them.", what does "disrupt" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: disrupt /dɪsˈrʌpt/ (động từ): làm gián đoạn, phá vỡ. "Disrupt references/work" = làm hỏng hoặc gián đoạn; tính từ: disruptive.
items.explanationEn: disrupt /dɪsˈrʌpt/ (verb): to interrupt or break. "Disrupt references or work" means breaking or interrupting them; adjective: disruptive.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not let ineffective practices hamper your ability to work sensibly.", từ "hamper" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not let ineffective practices hamper your ability to work sensibly.", what does "hamper" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: hamper /ˈhæm.pər/ (động từ): cản trở, gây khó khăn. "Hamper progress/your ability" = cản trở tiến độ/khả năng; đồng nghĩa: hinder.
items.explanationEn: hamper /ˈhæm.pər/ (verb): to hinder, to obstruct. "Hamper progress or your ability" means holding it back; synonym: hinder.

items.question: Trong câu "built by appending each line label to the parent labels above it.", từ "append" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "built by appending each line label to the parent labels above it.", what does "append" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: append /əˈpend/ (động từ): nối thêm vào cuối. "Append X to Y" = gắn X vào cuối Y; danh từ "appendix" là phụ lục.
items.explanationEn: append /əˈpend/ (verb): to add at the end. "Append X to Y" means attaching X at the end of Y; the related noun "appendix" is a section at the end.

items.question: Trong câu "Use the notation TBD (to be determined) to flag these knowledge gaps.", từ "flag" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use the notation TBD (to be determined) to flag these knowledge gaps.", what does "flag" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: flag /flæɡ/ (động từ): đánh dấu để lưu ý. "Flag an issue" = đánh dấu một vấn đề để người khác chú ý; "flag" còn có nghĩa là suy yếu dần.
items.explanationEn: flag /flæɡ/ (verb): to mark for attention. "Flag an issue" means marking it so others notice; "flag" can also mean to grow weaker.

items.question: Trong câu "When a developer encounters a TBD, they might make their best guess — which will not always be correct — instead of tracking down the requirement originator.", từ "track down" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a developer encounters a TBD, they might make their best guess — which will not always be correct — instead of tracking down the requirement originator.", what does "track down" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: track down /træk daʊn/ (cụm từ): tìm ra, lần ra được. "Track down the source/person" = lần theo để tìm ra nguồn/người cần hỏi.
items.explanationEn: track down /træk daʊn/ (phrase): to find after searching. "Track down the source or person" means searching until you find them.

items.question: Trong câu "Exploring possible interfaces with paper prototypes, mock-ups, wireframes, or simulation tools makes the requirements tangible for both users and developers.", từ "tangible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Exploring possible interfaces with paper prototypes, mock-ups, wireframes, or simulation tools makes the requirements tangible for both users and developers.", what does "tangible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: tangible /ˈtæn.dʒə.bəl/ (tính từ): cụ thể, hữu hình. "Make X tangible" = làm X trở nên cụ thể, dễ hình dung; cụm: tangible benefits (lợi ích thấy rõ).
items.explanationEn: tangible /ˈtæn.dʒə.bəl/ (adjective): concrete, able to be touched. "Make X tangible" means making it concrete and easy to picture; collocation: tangible benefits.

items.question: Trong câu "then those expectations belong in the realm of requirements.", từ "realm" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "then those expectations belong in the realm of requirements.", what does "realm" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: realm /relm/ (danh từ): lĩnh vực, phạm vi. "In the realm of X" = thuộc phạm vi X; nghĩa gốc là vương quốc.
items.explanationEn: realm /relm/ (noun): a field or domain. "In the realm of X" means within the field of X; the original sense is a kingdom.

items.question: Trong câu "just make sure you are not imposing constraints unnecessarily, prematurely, or for the wrong reasons.", từ "impose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "just make sure you are not imposing constraints unnecessarily, prematurely, or for the wrong reasons.", what does "impose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: impose /ɪmˈpəʊz/ (động từ): áp đặt. "Impose a constraint on someone" = áp đặt ràng buộc lên ai; "impose on someone" còn nghĩa là làm phiền.
items.explanationEn: impose /ɪmˈpəʊz/ (verb): to force something on others. "Impose a constraint on someone" forces it on them; "impose on someone" can also mean to trouble them.

items.question: Trong câu "As the team gets into each iteration, conversations among the product owner, BA, developers, testers, and users flesh out the details of each allocated story.", từ "flesh out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "As the team gets into each iteration, conversations among the product owner, BA, developers, testers, and users flesh out the details of each allocated story.", what does "flesh out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: flesh out /fleʃ aʊt/ (cụm từ): bổ sung chi tiết. "Flesh out a story/idea" = làm cho ý tưởng sơ sài trở nên đầy đủ, chi tiết.
items.explanationEn: flesh out /fleʃ aʊt/ (phrase): to add more detail. "Flesh out a story or idea" means turning a rough outline into something detailed.

items.question: Trong câu "Agile teams are not precluded from using other representation methods such as analysis models or a data dictionary.", từ "preclude" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agile teams are not precluded from using other representation methods such as analysis models or a data dictionary.", what does "preclude" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: preclude /prɪˈkluːd/ (động từ): ngăn cản, loại trừ. "Be precluded from doing X" = bị ngăn không được làm X; thường dùng trong văn bản trang trọng.
items.explanationEn: preclude /prɪˈkluːd/ (verb): to prevent, to rule out. "Be precluded from doing X" means being prevented from doing it; a formal verb.

items.question: Trong câu "Remember the overarching goal: accumulate a shared understanding good enough to construct the next portion of the product at an acceptable level of risk.", từ "overarching" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Remember the overarching goal: accumulate a shared understanding good enough to construct the next portion of the product at an acceptable level of risk.", what does "overarching" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: overarching /ˌəʊ.vəˈrɑː.tʃɪŋ/ (tính từ): bao trùm, tổng thể. "The overarching goal" = mục tiêu bao trùm, chi phối mọi việc khác.
items.explanationEn: overarching /ˌəʊ.vəˈrɑː.tʃɪŋ/ (adjective): most important, covering all. "The overarching goal" is the main aim that covers everything else.

items.question: Trong câu "If the team discards the original user stories after implementation, the only persistent documentation of the requirements is likely to be the acceptance tests — if they are stored in a tool.", từ "discard" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the team discards the original user stories after implementation, the only persistent documentation of the requirements is likely to be the acceptance tests — if they are stored in a tool.", what does "discard" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: discard /dɪˈskɑːd/ (động từ): loại bỏ, vứt đi. "Discard the cards/changes" = bỏ đi không giữ lại; trái nghĩa: keep, retain.
items.explanationEn: discard /dɪˈskɑːd/ (verb): to throw away. "Discard the cards or changes" means getting rid of them; opposites: keep, retain.

items.question: Trong câu "To assess the correctness of user requirements, user representatives or close surrogates should review them.", từ "surrogate" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "To assess the correctness of user requirements, user representatives or close surrogates should review them.", what does "surrogate" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a woman carrying a baby for others
items.explanation: surrogate /ˈsʌr.ə.ɡət/ (danh từ): người đại diện thay thế. "User surrogate" = người đóng vai thay người dùng thật (vd. BA, product owner) khi không gặp được người dùng.
items.explanationEn: surrogate /ˈsʌr.ə.ɡət/ (noun): a stand-in for someone. A "user surrogate" stands in for real users (e.g. a BA or product owner) when they are unavailable.

items.question: Trong câu "Incremental development and proof-of-concept prototypes are two ways to evaluate feasibility.", từ "feasibility" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Incremental development and proof-of-concept prototypes are two ways to evaluate feasibility.", what does "feasibility" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: feasibility /ˌfiː.zəˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): tính khả thi. "Evaluate feasibility" = đánh giá xem có làm được không; tính từ: feasible, trái nghĩa: infeasible.
items.explanationEn: feasibility /ˌfiː.zəˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): how possible something is. "Evaluate feasibility" means checking whether it can be done; adjective: feasible, opposite: infeasible.

items.question: Trong câu "A developer participating during elicitation provides a reality check.", từ "reality check" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A developer participating during elicitation provides a reality check.", what does "reality check" (phrase) mean?
options: sự đối chiếu với thực tế
items.explanation: reality check /riˈæl.ə.ti tʃek/ (cụm từ): sự đối chiếu với thực tế. "Provide a reality check" = giúp mọi người nhìn nhận điều gì là thực sự làm được.
items.explanationEn: reality check /riˈæl.ə.ti tʃek/ (phrase): a test against real limits. "Provide a reality check" means reminding people what is actually achievable.

items.question: Trong câu "Each requirement should describe a capability that provides the anticipated business value, differentiates the product, or is required for conformance to an external standard, policy, or regulation.", từ "conformance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each requirement should describe a capability that provides the anticipated business value, differentiates the product, or is required for conformance to an external standard, policy, or regulation.", what does "conformance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: conformance /kənˈfɔː.məns/ (danh từ): sự tuân thủ, phù hợp. "Conformance to a standard" = sự tuân thủ tiêu chuẩn; đồng nghĩa gần: compliance.
items.explanationEn: conformance /kənˈfɔː.məns/ (noun): meeting a rule or standard. "Conformance to a standard" means meeting it; a close synonym is compliance.

items.question: Trong câu "Every requirement should originate from a source with authority.", từ "originate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every requirement should originate from a source with authority.", what does "originate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to come from, to start from
items.explanation: originate /əˈrɪdʒ.ɪn.eɪt/ (động từ): bắt nguồn, xuất phát. "Originate from/in X" = bắt nguồn từ X; danh từ: origin, originator (người khởi xướng).
items.explanationEn: originate /əˈrɪdʒ.ɪn.eɪt/ (verb): to come from, to start from. "Originate from or in X" means to come from X; nouns: origin, originator.

items.question: Trong câu "If all requirements are equally important, the project manager does not know how best to respond to schedule overruns, personnel losses, or new requirements.", từ "overrun" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If all requirements are equally important, the project manager does not know how best to respond to schedule overruns, personnel losses, or new requirements.", what does "overrun" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: overrun /ˈəʊ.və.rʌn/ (danh từ): sự vượt quá (dự kiến). "Schedule/cost overrun" = sự vượt tiến độ/vượt chi phí dự kiến.
items.explanationEn: overrun /ˈəʊ.və.rʌn/ (noun): going past the planned limit. "Schedule or cost overrun" means exceeding the planned time or budget.

items.question: Trong câu "Natural language is prone to two types of ambiguity:", từ "prone to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Natural language is prone to two types of ambiguity:", what does "prone to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: prone to /prəʊn tuː/ (cụm từ): dễ mắc, dễ bị. "Be prone to errors" = dễ mắc lỗi; ghép từ: error-prone (dễ sinh lỗi).
items.explanationEn: prone to /prəʊn tuː/ (phrase): likely to suffer from. "Be prone to errors" means likely to have them; compound: error-prone.

items.question: Trong câu "The type you can spot yourself: when you can think of more than one way to interpret a requirement.", từ "interpret" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The type you can spot yourself: when you can think of more than one way to interpret a requirement.", what does "interpret" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: interpret /ɪnˈtɜː.prɪt/ (động từ): hiểu, diễn giải. "Interpret a requirement" = hiểu ý nghĩa của yêu cầu; danh từ: interpretation.
items.explanationEn: interpret /ɪnˈtɜː.prɪt/ (verb): to understand the meaning of. "Interpret a requirement" means deciding what it means; noun: interpretation.

items.question: Trong câu "Most of the time reasonable people draw the right conclusions from even a slightly fuzzy requirement.", từ "fuzzy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Most of the time reasonable people draw the right conclusions from even a slightly fuzzy requirement.", what does "fuzzy" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: fuzzy /ˈfʌz.i/ (tính từ): mơ hồ, không rõ ràng. "A fuzzy requirement" = yêu cầu mơ hồ; nghĩa đen là có lông tơ, xù.
items.explanationEn: fuzzy /ˈfʌz.i/ (adjective): unclear, not precise. "A fuzzy requirement" is vague; literally "fuzzy" means covered in soft hair.

items.question: Trong câu "Can a tester devise tests or other verification approaches to determine whether each requirement was properly implemented?", từ "devise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Can a tester devise tests or other verification approaches to determine whether each requirement was properly implemented?", what does "devise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: devise /dɪˈvaɪz/ (động từ): nghĩ ra, thiết kế. "Devise a test/plan" = nghĩ ra một bài kiểm thử/kế hoạch; đừng nhầm với "device" (thiết bị).
items.explanationEn: devise /dɪˈvaɪz/ (verb): to invent, to plan out. "Devise a test or plan" means creating one; do not confuse it with the noun "device".

items.question: Trong câu "there are always some assumed or implied requirements — but they carry more risk than explicitly stated ones.", từ "explicitly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "there are always some assumed or implied requirements — but they carry more risk than explicitly stated ones.", what does "explicitly" (adverb) mean?
options: một cách rõ ràng, tường minh
items.explanation: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt.li/ (trạng từ): một cách rõ ràng, tường minh. "Explicitly stated" = được nêu rõ ràng; trái nghĩa: implicitly (ngầm).
items.explanationEn: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt.li/ (adverb): in a clear, direct way. "Explicitly stated" means said clearly; the opposite is implicitly.

items.question: Trong câu "If you do not resolve contradictions before diving into construction, the developers will have to deal with them.", từ "contradiction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you do not resolve contradictions before diving into construction, the developers will have to deal with them.", what does "contradiction" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: contradiction /ˌkɒn.trəˈdɪk.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự mâu thuẫn. "Resolve contradictions" = giải quyết các mâu thuẫn; động từ: contradict.
items.explanationEn: contradiction /ˌkɒn.trəˈdɪk.ʃən/ (noun): a conflict between statements. "Resolve contradictions" means removing conflicts; verb: contradict.

items.question: Trong câu "Modifiability dictates that each requirement be uniquely labelled and expressed separately from others so you can refer to it unambiguously.", từ "dictate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Modifiability dictates that each requirement be uniquely labelled and expressed separately from others so you can refer to it unambiguously.", what does "dictate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: dictate /dɪkˈteɪt/ (động từ): đòi hỏi, quy định. "X dictates that..." = X đòi hỏi phải...; nghĩa khác: đọc cho người khác chép.
items.explanationEn: dictate /dɪkˈteɪt/ (verb): to require, to determine. "X dictates that..." means X requires it; another sense is speaking words for someone to write down.

items.question: Trong câu "Storing each requirement JUST ONCE in a requirements management tool solves the redundancy problem and facilitates reusing common requirements across projects.", từ "facilitate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Storing each requirement JUST ONCE in a requirements management tool solves the redundancy problem and facilitates reusing common requirements across projects.", what does "facilitate" (verb) mean?
options: tạo điều kiện, giúp dễ dàng
items.explanation: facilitate /fəˈsɪl.ɪ.teɪt/ (động từ): tạo điều kiện, giúp dễ dàng. "Facilitate reuse" = giúp tái sử dụng dễ hơn; danh từ: facilitator (người điều phối).
items.explanationEn: facilitate /fəˈsɪl.ɪ.teɪt/ (verb): to make easier. "Facilitate reuse" makes reuse easier; noun: facilitator (someone who guides a session).

items.question: Trong câu "Traceable requirements are uniquely labelled with persistent identifiers and written in a structured, fine-grained way — not in long narrative paragraphs.", từ "fine-grained" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Traceable requirements are uniquely labelled with persistent identifiers and written in a structured, fine-grained way — not in long narrative paragraphs.", what does "fine-grained" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: fine-grained /ˌfaɪnˈɡreɪnd/ (tính từ): chi tiết, chia nhỏ. "Fine-grained requirements" = yêu cầu chia nhỏ mức chi tiết; trái nghĩa: coarse-grained.
items.explanationEn: fine-grained /ˌfaɪnˈɡreɪnd/ (adjective): split into small detailed parts. "Fine-grained requirements" are broken into small pieces; the opposite is coarse-grained.

items.question: Trong câu "The best teachers are experience and feedback from the recipients of your requirements.", từ "recipient" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The best teachers are experience and feedback from the recipients of your requirements.", what does "recipient" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: recipient /rɪˈsɪp.i.ənt/ (danh từ): người nhận. "The recipients of X" = những người nhận X; hay gặp trong email: recipient list.
items.explanationEn: recipient /rɪˈsɪp.i.ənt/ (noun): a person who receives. "The recipients of X" are the people who receive it; common in email: recipient list.

items.question: Trong câu "To get started, buddy up with a fellow BA and exchange requirements for review.", từ "buddy up" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "To get started, buddy up with a fellow BA and exchange requirements for review.", what does "buddy up" (phrase) mean?
options: bắt cặp, kết đôi làm việc
items.explanation: buddy up /ˈbʌd.i ʌp/ (cụm từ): bắt cặp, kết đôi làm việc. "Buddy up with someone" = kết cặp với ai để cùng làm/hỗ trợ nhau (khẩu ngữ).
items.explanationEn: buddy up /ˈbʌd.i ʌp/ (phrase): to pair with someone. "Buddy up with someone" means pairing up to work together (informal).

items.question: Trong câu "These outcomes are more important than purity of style or dogmatically conforming to some arbitrary rule.", từ "arbitrary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These outcomes are more important than purity of style or dogmatically conforming to some arbitrary rule.", what does "arbitrary" (adjective) mean?
options: tuỳ tiện, không có lý do
items.explanation: arbitrary /ˈɑː.bɪ.trər.i/ (tính từ): tuỳ tiện, không có lý do. "An arbitrary rule" = quy tắc đặt ra tuỳ tiện; trong lập trình "arbitrary" còn là "bất kỳ".
items.explanationEn: arbitrary /ˈɑː.bɪ.trər.i/ (adjective): chosen without good reason. "An arbitrary rule" has no real reason behind it; in programming "arbitrary" also means "any".

items.question: Trong câu "Because effective communication is the overarching goal, it is fine to intermingle these styles — phrase each requirement in whichever style is clearer.", từ "intermingle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Because effective communication is the overarching goal, it is fine to intermingle these styles — phrase each requirement in whichever style is clearer.", what does "intermingle" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: intermingle /ˌɪn.təˈmɪŋ.ɡəl/ (động từ): trộn lẫn, xen lẫn. "Intermingle styles" = dùng xen lẫn nhiều phong cách; đồng nghĩa: mix.
items.explanationEn: intermingle /ˌɪn.təˈmɪŋ.ɡəl/ (verb): to mix together. "Intermingle styles" means mixing them; synonym: mix.

items.question: Trong câu "Some writers omit it, arguing that because requirements describe system behaviour there is no need to repeat it.", từ "omit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Some writers omit it, arguing that because requirements describe system behaviour there is no need to repeat it.", what does "omit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: omit /əʊˈmɪt/ (động từ): bỏ đi, lược bỏ. "Omit a word/section" = lược bỏ; danh từ: omission (sự bỏ sót).
items.explanationEn: omit /əʊˈmɪt/ (verb): to leave out. "Omit a word or section" means leaving it out; noun: omission.

items.question: Trong câu "This structure helps readers who are skimming while still serving thorough readers.", từ "skim" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This structure helps readers who are skimming while still serving thorough readers.", what does "skim" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: skim /skɪm/ (động từ): đọc lướt. "Skim a document" = đọc lướt tìm ý chính; nghĩa khác: hớt lớp váng trên mặt chất lỏng.
items.explanationEn: skim /skɪm/ (verb): to read quickly. "Skim a document" means reading it quickly for main points; also removing a layer from a liquid.

items.question: Trong câu "Precisely stated requirements increase the chance people get what they expect; less specific ones offer developers more latitude.", từ "latitude" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Precisely stated requirements increase the chance people get what they expect; less specific ones offer developers more latitude.", what does "latitude" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: latitude /ˈlæt.ɪ.tjuːd/ (danh từ): sự tự do lựa chọn. "Give someone latitude" = cho ai quyền tự quyết; trong địa lý là vĩ độ.
items.explanationEn: latitude /ˈlæt.ɪ.tjuːd/ (noun): freedom to choose. "Give someone latitude" means allowing them freedom; in geography it means distance north or south.

items.question: Trong câu "Nuances between different verbs also make the document far harder for cross-cultural teams to interpret consistently.", từ "nuance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Nuances between different verbs also make the document far harder for cross-cultural teams to interpret consistently.", what does "nuance" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a short form of a word
items.explanation: nuance /ˈnjuː.ɑːns/ (danh từ): sắc thái (nghĩa). "Subtle nuances" = những sắc thái tinh tế; tính từ: nuanced (tinh tế, nhiều sắc thái).
items.explanationEn: nuance /ˈnjuː.ɑːns/ (noun): a subtle difference. "Subtle nuances" are small differences in meaning; adjective: nuanced.

items.question: Trong câu "Such conventions risk some readers not understanding the distinction between words people use interchangeably in everyday conversation.", từ "interchangeably" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Such conventions risk some readers not understanding the distinction between words people use interchangeably in everyday conversation.", what does "interchangeably" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: interchangeably /ˌɪn.təˈtʃeɪn.dʒə.bli/ (trạng từ): thay thế cho nhau. "Use X and Y interchangeably" = dùng X và Y như nhau, có thể thay nhau.
items.explanationEn: interchangeably /ˌɪn.təˈtʃeɪn.dʒə.bli/ (adverb): in place of each other. "Use X and Y interchangeably" means treating them as equivalent.

items.question: Trong câu "Readers should not have to glean the individual requirements embedded in a mass of free-flowing text.", từ "glean" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Readers should not have to glean the individual requirements embedded in a mass of free-flowing text.", what does "glean" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: glean /ɡliːn/ (động từ): lọc ra, thu lượm dần. "Glean information from X" = chắt lọc thông tin từ X một cách khó nhọc; nghĩa gốc là mót lúa.
items.explanationEn: glean /ɡliːn/ (verb): to gather bit by bit. "Glean information from X" means collecting it with effort; originally, gathering leftover grain.

items.question: Trong câu "Other readers might well come to different conclusions about exactly which requirements were lurking in that text.", từ "lurk" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Other readers might well come to different conclusions about exactly which requirements were lurking in that text.", what does "lurk" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: lurk /lɜːk/ (động từ): ẩn nấp, tiềm ẩn. "Lurking in the text" = ẩn giấu trong văn bản, khó thấy; hay dùng cho lỗi, rủi ro.
items.explanationEn: lurk /lɜːk/ (verb): to be hidden, unseen. "Lurking in the text" means hidden and hard to see; often used for bugs or risks.

items.question: Trong câu "An important part of requirements analysis is decomposing a high-level requirement into sufficient detail to clarify and flesh it out.", từ "decompose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An important part of requirements analysis is decomposing a high-level requirement into sufficient detail to clarify and flesh it out.", what does "decompose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: decompose /ˌdiː.kəmˈpəʊz/ (động từ): phân rã, chia nhỏ. "Decompose X into Y" = chia X thành các phần Y nhỏ hơn; trong sinh học là phân huỷ.
items.explanationEn: decompose /ˌdiː.kəmˈpəʊz/ (verb): to break into parts. "Decompose X into Y" means breaking X into smaller parts; in biology it means to rot.

items.question: Trong câu "Authors often struggle to find the right granularity.", từ "granularity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Authors often struggle to find the right granularity.", what does "granularity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: granularity /ˌɡræn.jəˈlær.ə.ti/ (danh từ): mức độ chi tiết. "At a consistent granularity" = ở cùng một mức độ chi tiết; tính từ: granular.
items.explanationEn: granularity /ˌɡræn.jəˈlær.ə.ti/ (noun): level of detail. "At a consistent granularity" means at the same level of detail; adjective: granular.

items.question: Trong câu "If you envision numerous and diverse tests, perhaps several requirements are combined and ought to be separated.", từ "envision" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you envision numerous and diverse tests, perhaps several requirements are combined and ought to be separated.", what does "envision" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: envision /ɪnˈvɪʒ.ən/ (động từ): hình dung, mường tượng. "Envision a future/solution" = hình dung trước; đồng nghĩa: imagine, foresee.
items.explanationEn: envision /ɪnˈvɪʒ.ən/ (verb): to picture in the mind. "Envision a future or solution" means picturing it in advance; synonyms: imagine, foresee.

items.question: Trong câu "This single requirement — seemingly no larger or smaller than all the others — actually stipulated the inclusion of a complex speech-recognition subsystem, virtually an entire product in its own right!", từ "stipulate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This single requirement — seemingly no larger or smaller than all the others — actually stipulated the inclusion of a complex speech-recognition subsystem, virtually an entire product in its own right!", what does "stipulate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: stipulate /ˈstɪp.jə.leɪt/ (động từ): quy định, đòi hỏi. "The contract stipulates that..." = hợp đồng quy định rằng...; danh từ: stipulation.
items.explanationEn: stipulate /ˈstɪp.jə.leɪt/ (verb): to state as required. "The contract stipulates that..." means it demands it; noun: stipulation.

items.question: Trong câu "actually stipulated the inclusion of a complex speech-recognition subsystem, virtually an entire product in its own right!", từ "virtually" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "actually stipulated the inclusion of a complex speech-recognition subsystem, virtually an entire product in its own right!", what does "virtually" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: virtually /ˈvɜː.tʃu.ə.li/ (trạng từ): gần như, hầu như. "Virtually impossible" = gần như không thể; nghĩa khác: "meet virtually" = gặp trực tuyến.
items.explanationEn: virtually /ˈvɜː.tʃu.ə.li/ (adverb): almost, nearly. "Virtually impossible" means almost impossible; another sense: "meet virtually" means meeting online.

items.question: Trong câu "Readers eyes glaze over when confronting a dense mass of turgid text or a long list of similar-looking requirements.", từ "turgid" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Readers eyes glaze over when confronting a dense mass of turgid text or a long list of similar-looking requirements.", what does "turgid" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: turgid /ˈtɜː.dʒɪd/ (tính từ): nặng nề, khó đọc. "Turgid prose" = văn viết nặng nề, rườm rà; nghĩa đen là sưng phồng.
items.explanationEn: turgid /ˈtɜː.dʒɪd/ (adjective): heavy and hard to read. "Turgid prose" is dull and overcomplicated; literally "turgid" means swollen.

items.question: Trong câu "These will not suffice as substitutes in many cases, but they serve as excellent supplemental information to enhance understanding.", từ "supplemental" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These will not suffice as substitutes in many cases, but they serve as excellent supplemental information to enhance understanding.", what does "supplemental" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: supplemental /ˌsʌp.lɪˈmen.təl/ (tính từ): bổ sung, phụ thêm. "Supplemental information" = thông tin bổ sung; đồng nghĩa: supplementary.
items.explanationEn: supplemental /ˌsʌp.lɪˈmen.təl/ (adjective): added as extra. "Supplemental information" is extra information; synonym: supplementary.

items.question: Trong câu "The analyst may believe a requirement is crystal clear and free from ambiguity.", từ "crystal clear" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The analyst may believe a requirement is crystal clear and free from ambiguity.", what does "crystal clear" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: crystal clear /ˌkrɪs.təl ˈklɪər/ (cụm từ): rõ như ban ngày. "Make it crystal clear" = làm cho hoàn toàn rõ ràng, không thể hiểu nhầm.
items.explanationEn: crystal clear /ˌkrɪs.təl ˈklɪər/ (phrase): completely clear. "Make it crystal clear" means leaving no room for misunderstanding.

items.question: Trong câu "Pick one term and use it consistently, placing synonyms in the glossary so people accustomed to another name see the connection.", từ "accustomed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pick one term and use it consistently, placing synonyms in the glossary so people accustomed to another name see the connection.", what does "accustomed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: accustomed /əˈkʌs.təmd/ (tính từ): quen với. "Be accustomed to X" = đã quen với X; đừng nhầm với "customer".
items.explanationEn: accustomed /əˈkʌs.təmd/ (adjective): used to. "Be accustomed to X" means being used to it; not related in meaning to "customer".

items.question: Trong câu "If you use a pronoun to refer to something mentioned earlier, make sure the antecedent is crystal clear.", từ "antecedent" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you use a pronoun to refer to something mentioned earlier, make sure the antecedent is crystal clear.", what does "antecedent" (noun) mean?
options: từ mà đại từ thay thế
optionsEn: the word a pronoun refers to
items.explanation: antecedent /ˌæn.tɪˈsiː.dənt/ (danh từ): từ mà đại từ thay thế. Trong ngữ pháp, "antecedent" là danh từ đứng trước mà đại từ (it, they...) thay thế; nghĩa khác: tổ tiên.
items.explanationEn: antecedent /ˌæn.tɪˈsiː.dənt/ (noun): the word a pronoun refers to. In grammar the "antecedent" is the earlier noun a pronoun (it, they...) stands for; another sense is ancestor.

items.question: Trong câu "Adverbs introduce subjectivity and hence ambiguity.", từ "subjectivity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Adverbs introduce subjectivity and hence ambiguity.", what does "subjectivity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: subjectivity /ˌsʌb.dʒekˈtɪv.ə.ti/ (danh từ): tính chủ quan. "Introduce subjectivity" = đưa yếu tố cảm tính cá nhân vào; trái nghĩa: objectivity.
items.explanationEn: subjectivity /ˌsʌb.dʒekˈtɪv.ə.ti/ (noun): personal judgement. "Introduce subjectivity" means adding personal opinion; the opposite is objectivity.

items.question: Trong câu "An excellent test for ambiguity: think of a ludicrous but legitimate interpretation.", từ "ludicrous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An excellent test for ambiguity: think of a ludicrous but legitimate interpretation.", what does "ludicrous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ludicrous /ˈluː.dɪ.krəs/ (tính từ): lố bịch, vô lý. "A ludicrous idea" = một ý tưởng nực cười; đồng nghĩa: absurd, ridiculous.
items.explanationEn: ludicrous /ˈluː.dɪ.krəs/ (adjective): absurd, ridiculous. "A ludicrous idea" is laughably unreasonable; synonyms: absurd, ridiculous.

items.question: Trong câu "think of a ludicrous but legitimate interpretation.", từ "legitimate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "think of a ludicrous but legitimate interpretation.", what does "legitimate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: legitimate /lɪˈdʒɪt.ə.mət/ (tính từ): hợp lệ, chính đáng. "A legitimate interpretation/reason" = cách hiểu/lý do chính đáng; nghĩa cũ: con trong giá thú.
items.explanationEn: legitimate /lɪˈdʒɪt.ə.mət/ (adjective): valid, allowed. "A legitimate interpretation or reason" is a valid one; an older sense refers to a child of married parents.

items.question: Trong câu "Alternatively, if the intent is that at most 60 seconds elapse between messages, would one millisecond be too short?", từ "elapse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Alternatively, if the intent is that at most 60 seconds elapse between messages, would one millisecond be too short?", what does "elapse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: elapse /ɪˈlæps/ (động từ): trôi qua (thời gian). "Time elapses" = thời gian trôi qua; "elapsed time" = thời gian đã trôi qua.
items.explanationEn: elapse /ɪˈlæps/ (verb): to pass (of time). "Time elapses" means it passes; "elapsed time" is how much time has passed.

items.question: Trong câu "display a Done message when complete; and display a message if the task has stalled.", từ "stall" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "display a Done message when complete; and display a message if the task has stalled.", what does "stall" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: stall /stɔːl/ (động từ): bị đình trệ, đứng lại. "The task has stalled" = tác vụ bị treo, không tiến triển; danh từ "stall" còn là quầy hàng.
items.explanationEn: stall /stɔːl/ (verb): to stop making progress. "The task has stalled" means it stopped progressing; the noun "stall" is also a market stand.

items.question: Trong câu "Unnecessarily constrained design options frustrate programmers and can result in a suboptimal product design.", từ "suboptimal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Unnecessarily constrained design options frustrate programmers and can result in a suboptimal product design.", what does "suboptimal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: suboptimal /sʌbˈɒp.tɪ.məl/ (tính từ): chưa tối ưu. "A suboptimal design/solution" = thiết kế/giải pháp chưa phải tốt nhất.
items.explanationEn: suboptimal /sʌbˈɒp.tɪ.məl/ (adjective): not the best possible. "A suboptimal design or solution" works but is not the best one.

items.question: Trong câu "you deliberately impose the design constraint for a very good reason.", từ "deliberately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "you deliberately impose the design constraint for a very good reason.", what does "deliberately" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: deliberately /dɪˈlɪb.ər.ət.li/ (trạng từ): cố ý, có chủ đích. "Deliberately" = cố tình làm vì có lý do; trái nghĩa: accidentally.
items.explanationEn: deliberately /dɪˈlɪb.ər.ət.li/ (adverb): on purpose. "Deliberately" means doing it on purpose for a reason; opposite: accidentally.

items.question: Trong câu "Quantify how much improvement is adequate", từ "quantify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Quantify how much improvement is adequate", what does "quantify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: quantify /ˈkwɒn.tɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): định lượng. "Quantify the improvement" = diễn đạt mức cải thiện bằng con số cụ thể; tính từ: quantifiable.
items.explanationEn: quantify /ˈkwɒn.tɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to measure in numbers. "Quantify the improvement" means stating it as a number; adjective: quantifiable.

items.question: Trong câu "Double and triple negatives are particularly tricky to decipher.", từ "decipher" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Double and triple negatives are particularly tricky to decipher.", what does "decipher" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: decipher /dɪˈsaɪ.fər/ (động từ): giải nghĩa, hiểu ra. "Hard to decipher" = khó đọc/khó hiểu; nghĩa gốc là giải mã một thông điệp.
items.explanationEn: decipher /dɪˈsaɪ.fər/ (verb): to work out the meaning. "Hard to decipher" means hard to understand; originally, to decode a secret message.

items.question: Trong câu "If a specific requirement was once in scope but then removed, you do not want to lose sight of it — it has a way of reappearing.", từ "lose sight of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If a specific requirement was once in scope but then removed, you do not want to lose sight of it — it has a way of reappearing.", what does "lose sight of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: lose sight of /luːz saɪt ɒv/ (cụm từ): quên mất, không theo dõi. "Lose sight of the goal" = quên mất mục tiêu; nghĩa đen là không còn nhìn thấy.
items.explanationEn: lose sight of /luːz saɪt ɒv/ (phrase): to stop keeping track of. "Lose sight of the goal" means forgetting about it; literally, no longer being able to see it.

items.question: Trong câu "Symmetrical operations are a common source of missing requirements.", từ "symmetrical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Symmetrical operations are a common source of missing requirements.", what does "symmetrical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: symmetrical /sɪˈmet.rɪ.kəl/ (tính từ): đối xứng, đi thành cặp. "Symmetrical operations" = thao tác đi cặp như lưu/mở, thêm/xoá; danh từ: symmetry.
items.explanationEn: symmetrical /sɪˈmet.rɪ.kəl/ (adjective): matching in pairs. "Symmetrical operations" come in pairs such as save/retrieve or add/delete; noun: symmetry.

items.question: Trong câu "Compound logical expressions often leave certain combinations of decision values undefined.", từ "compound" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Compound logical expressions often leave certain combinations of decision values undefined.", what does "compound" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: compound /ˈkɒm.paʊnd/ (tính từ): phức hợp, ghép nhiều phần. "A compound condition" = điều kiện ghép (A and B); "compound interest" = lãi kép.
items.explanationEn: compound /ˈkɒm.paʊnd/ (adjective): made of several parts. "A compound condition" joins parts like A and B; "compound interest" is interest on interest.

items.question: Trong câu "Each requirement that states how the system should work when everything is correct should also have accompanying requirements describing how the system responds when exceptions occur.", từ "accompany" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each requirement that states how the system should work when everything is correct should also have accompanying requirements describing how the system responds when exceptions occur.", what does "accompany" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to play music for a singer
items.explanation: accompany /əˈkʌm.pə.ni/ (động từ): đi kèm theo. "Accompanying requirements" = các yêu cầu đi kèm; nghĩa khác: đệm đàn cho ca sĩ.
items.explanationEn: accompany /əˈkʌm.pə.ni/ (verb): to go together with. "Accompanying requirements" go along with the main one; another sense is playing music for a singer.

items.question: Trong câu "How exactly can the system determine which database is the authoritative source?", từ "authoritative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How exactly can the system determine which database is the authoritative source?", what does "authoritative" (adjective) mean?
options: chính thức, đáng tin cậy nhất
items.explanation: authoritative /ɔːˈθɒr.ə.tə.tɪv/ (tính từ): chính thức, đáng tin cậy nhất. "The authoritative source" = nguồn dữ liệu chuẩn, được tin là đúng; với người thì còn là "uy quyền".
items.explanationEn: authoritative /ɔːˈθɒr.ə.tə.tɪv/ (adjective): officially trusted as correct. "The authoritative source" is the trusted master copy; for a person it can mean commanding.

items.question: Trong câu "What information should the system send to the Security Compliance Team when it detects a discrepancy?", từ "discrepancy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What information should the system send to the Security Compliance Team when it detects a discrepancy?", what does "discrepancy" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: discrepancy /dɪˈskrep.ən.si/ (danh từ): sự chênh lệch, không khớp. "Detect a discrepancy between A and B" = phát hiện A và B không khớp nhau.
items.explanationEn: discrepancy /dɪˈskrep.ən.si/ (noun): a mismatch between data. "Detect a discrepancy between A and B" means finding that they do not match.

items.question: Trong câu "A final trap: Watch out for analysis paralysis.", từ "paralysis" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A final trap: Watch out for analysis paralysis.", what does "paralysis" (noun) mean?
options: sự trì trệ, không hành động được
sự hấp tấp, vội vàng quá mức
items.explanation: paralysis /pəˈræl.ə.sɪs/ (danh từ): sự trì trệ, không hành động được. "Analysis paralysis" = phân tích mãi mà không ra quyết định; nghĩa y học là bại liệt.
items.explanationEn: paralysis /pəˈræl.ə.sɪs/ (noun): inability to act or decide. "Analysis paralysis" means over-analysing and never deciding; the medical sense is loss of movement.

items.question: Trong câu "The cost of recording knowledge is small compared with the cost of reacquiring it later.", từ "reacquire" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The cost of recording knowledge is small compared with the cost of reacquiring it later.", what does "reacquire" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reacquire /ˌriː.əˈkwaɪər/ (động từ): thu thập lại, có lại. "Reacquire knowledge" = phải tìm hiểu lại kiến thức đã mất; gốc: acquire (thu được).
items.explanationEn: reacquire /ˌriː.əˈkwaɪər/ (verb): to obtain again. "Reacquire knowledge" means having to learn it again; root: acquire.

items.question: Trong câu "Tables prevent omission and duplication errors in similar requirement sets; use N/A for inapplicable cells.", từ "omission" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Tables prevent omission and duplication errors in similar requirement sets; use N/A for inapplicable cells.", what does "omission" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: omission /əʊˈmɪʃ.ən/ (danh từ): sự bỏ sót. "Errors of omission" = lỗi do bỏ sót; động từ: omit.
items.explanationEn: omission /əʊˈmɪʃ.ən/ (noun): something left out. "Errors of omission" come from leaving something out; verb: omit.

items.question: Trong câu "Tables prevent omission and duplication errors in similar requirement sets; use N/A for inapplicable cells.", từ "inapplicable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Tables prevent omission and duplication errors in similar requirement sets; use N/A for inapplicable cells.", what does "inapplicable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: inapplicable /ɪnˈæp.lɪ.kə.bəl/ (tính từ): không áp dụng được. "N/A" viết tắt của "not applicable" = không áp dụng; trái nghĩa: applicable.
items.explanationEn: inapplicable /ɪnˈæp.lɪ.kə.bəl/ (adjective): not relevant here. "N/A" stands for "not applicable"; the opposite is applicable.

items.question: Trong câu "Adopt standard templates and adapt them to the types and sizes of projects your organization undertakes.", từ "undertake" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Adopt standard templates and adapt them to the types and sizes of projects your organization undertakes.", what does "undertake" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to take on, to carry out
items.explanation: undertake /ˌʌn.dəˈteɪk/ (động từ): đảm nhận, tiến hành. "Undertake a project" = nhận làm một dự án; danh từ: undertaking (công việc đảm nhận).
items.explanationEn: undertake /ˌʌn.dəˈteɪk/ (verb): to take on, to carry out. "Undertake a project" means taking it on; noun: undertaking.

items.question: Trong câu "Actively hunt for ambiguity and incompleteness using peer reviews, the terms-to-avoid table, decision tables, and symmetry checks.", từ "hunt for" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Actively hunt for ambiguity and incompleteness using peer reviews, the terms-to-avoid table, decision tables, and symmetry checks.", what does "hunt for" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: hunt for /hʌnt fɔːr/ (cụm từ): săn tìm, lùng tìm. "Hunt for bugs/ambiguity" = chủ động lùng tìm lỗi/chỗ mơ hồ; nghĩa đen là đi săn.
items.explanationEn: hunt for /hʌnt fɔːr/ (phrase): to search hard for. "Hunt for bugs or ambiguity" means actively searching for them; literally, chasing animals.
